conclusion: The 19 unresolvable lists are HubSpot SYSTEM-GENERATED workflow-membership lists, not curated audiences. Each is auto-created to back a criterion like 'is enrolled in workflow X'. They disappeared because the 13 workflows they were derived from were deleted -- HubSpot garbage-collects the membership list with its workflow. Nobody deleted 19 lists.
why: metadata.inListType names the membership type and metadata.id names the workflow, so every clause is self-describing: 'in/not-in <type> of workflow <id>'.
impact: These clauses are legacy suppression guards against workflows that no longer exist, so they can never match. They are no-ops to DELETE, not audiences to rebuild.
